findings.description: The server state probe never reports the lock state of USE_<MATERIAL>_TOOLS (null in all 210 state lines), contrary to the brief's row anatomy. The lock is still provable from count < threshold in the state line, the ability-specific client overlay text and the absence of effect, so verdicts are reproducible, but the server-side excerpt alone does not show the lock state.

No server-side decision line for the tool guard: the only plugin event is ATD_EVENT LEFT_CLICK_BLOCK cancelled=false blockResult=ALLOW; the denial is shown only by the block surviving the 60-tick attack, the unchanged count and the client overlay. Verdicts are reproducible, but a direct guard log line would make the evidence self-contained.

Despite the group name 'each_native_mode', only one route is exercised per material: a pickaxe mining stone. Sword/axe combat (COMBAT mode), hoe/shovel/axe use and the other tool items of each material have no runtime row. Coverage meets the brief's checklist, but the group title overstates it.

The final report lists 'offhand:offhand_allowed, offhand:offhand_locked' as extra passes for this group, but no offhand row for any *_tools ability exists in rows.jsonl or in any campaign*/receipts/campaign-results.jsonl. The report text is inaccurate; the product evidence is unaffected.
